### The Sign of Jonah
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/the-sign-of-jonah-one-year-devotions-for-men-september-14.html
Passage: Luke 11:29
Points:
- Demanding further miraculous signs stems from hard-hearted unbelief rather than an honest lack of evidence.
- Jesus declared that the only sign granted to His generation would be the sign of Jonah.
- Jonah's deliverance foreshadowed Jesus rising from the grave after three days in death.
- The resurrection offers more than sufficient grounds to believe that Jesus is the Son of God.
- Rejecting the clear evidence of the risen Christ is a willful choice to remain in unbelief.

### The Sign of Jonah
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/sign-jonah
Passage: Matthew 12:38-42
Points:
- The scribes and Pharisees insincerely demanded a miracle, seeking ammunition rather than genuine truth.
- Jesus refused to perform signs on demand but promised the sign of Jonah.
- Jonah's deliverance prefigured Christ's bodily resurrection, which fully vindicates His identity and message.
- The repentant Ninevites and the Queen of the South will condemn Israel for rejecting Someone far greater.
- No amount of supernatural proof will persuade a heart that loves sin and refuses to repent.
